label: KODACHROME 64 Film / KR
source: Eastman Kodak technical data E-88 'KODACHROME 64 and 200 Films' (June 2009, minor revision 6-09), KODACHROME 64 curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 4)

sensitometry.x_unit: log10 exposure H (lux-seconds), absolute, as printed on the chart

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal of exposure in erg/cm2 required to produce E.N.D. density 1.00)

dye_density.unit: diffuse spectral density; dyes normalized to form a visual density of 1.0 for a 3200 K viewing illuminant

granularity.note: Diffuse rms granularity read at a gross diffuse visual density of 1.0, 48 um aperture, 12X magnification; single published value, no granularity curve

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Eastman Kodak Company. Characteristic curves: Exposure Daylight 1/50 s, Process K-14, Densitometry Status A. The datasheet gives no Log H Ref, reference exposure or mid-grey point, so log_h_ref is omitted and x stays in absolute log H as printed; x labels use bar notation (3-bar.0 = -3.0) drawn as separate strokes. Density includes base and is made monotone non-increasing by running minimum. Spectral sensitivity: Effective exposure 1.4 s, Process K-14, Densitometry E.N.D., Density 1.00; curves labelled Yellow-, Magenta-, Cyan-Forming Layer are stored as b, g, r. Spectral dye density: Cyan, Magenta, Yellow and Visual Neutral published, normalized for a 3200 K viewing illuminant; no D-min or midscale-neutral curve is published. viewing: datasheet says transparencies are for projection or viewing with 5000 K illumination. balance: daylight or electronic flash (EI 64); tungsten 3200 K needs WRATTEN 80A (EI 16), photolamp 3400 K needs 80B (EI 20). Not digitized: modulation-transfer curve. Not published: Print Grain Index, granularity curve. The same publication's page 5 holds KODACHROME 200 data, not used here.

scan.note: fitted to 99 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871922453-kodachrome-64/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
